description: External-truth reference trials. k=2: the 2-SAT threshold is proved to be 1 (Chvatal-Reed 1992; Goerdt 1996; Fernandez de la Vega 1992), so the method must certify UNSAT above 1 for some law and must never certify below 1. k=3: the epoch-2 k3_reference input (law of Vorobyev 2026 at 4.268), whose Psi_128 value is published there; reproduced as a formula-identity check only.

trials.name: k2_T128_at_1.1
trials.role: positive control at a density above the proven 2-SAT threshold 1

trials.name: k2_T128_at_0.95
trials.role: negative control below the proven 2-SAT threshold: must be rejected with Psi > 0

trials.name: k3_reference
trials.role: epoch-2 k3_reference input (Vorobyev 2026 trial at 4.268), formula-identity cross-check
